apps.message:
ci: publish from the gh-pages branch, with a preview per pull request

## Intent

Changes to the app overview should be reviewable in the browser before they reach main. Every pull request needs its own review environment.

## Key changes

- pages.yml builds, checks and publishes main to the root of gh-pages, served at lernapps.net/apps/.
- pr-preview.yml publishes each pull request under pr-preview/pr-<number>/, links it in a comment, updates it on every push and removes it when the pull request closes.
- The path prefix is configurable (SITE_PATH_PREFIX); previews show a banner and are not indexed.
- Pull requests from forks and from Dependabot get no preview: their token is read-only, so the run would fail.

## Dependencies and side effects

- The home page gets the same setup in lernapps.github.io (48ccf73, ba9d09f, i223).
- Pages of the repo must be switched to deploy from the gh-pages branch.

moved.why: Fixes this request's preview workflow for Dependabot pull requests; found while setting up the same workflow for the home page.
